The Prisma AIRS Harness engine runs on this Mac. Every answer comes from your AI Gateway workspace, with its inference key or your company sign-in, and nothing else. Each conversation is saved on this Mac after every answer, encrypted, and can be continued later with the same credential. Changing the tenant, the workspace or its credential, sleep or quitting ends the running conversation. It can read this tenant through the app’s own tools, propose changes you review in Administration, and, in a folder you choose, run commands and change files only with your approval.
